description: Read your RentalReady owner space from Claude: bookings, revenue, occupancy and property details.
long_description:
Reads the RentalReady owner portal (pms.rentalready.io) as you: this month's occupancy and net revenue, every reservation with its financial breakdown (rent, commission, cleaning, platform fees, tourist tax), monthly totals, a year-end projection, and your property's details.

Setup:
1. In Google Chrome (or Arc, Brave, Edge), sign in to https://pms.rentalready.io with your owner account, including the two-factor code.
2. In Claude, ask: "how is my RentalReady rental doing this month?". The first time, macOS asks whether `security` may use the browser's "Safe Storage" keychain item: type your Mac password and click Always Allow. This is how the extension reuses your browser session; nothing is sent anywhere else.

The portal signs you out after about two weeks. When Claude says the session expired, sign in to pms.rentalready.io in Chrome again and ask once more.
